notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Update 1.1 is already available for you.


Patch Notes:
-  Added achievements
- Fixed some grammatical errors
- Fixed crashes on chapters 5 and 7
- Cut the initial splash screen with a warning(temporarily)

Plans for the next updates:
-  Version for Mac and Linux(in the next few weeks)
-  Image gallery
- Free demo version
- Free soundtrack(for owners)
- Updating the game's interface and graphics
- Story DLC(not confirmed)

If you find a bug or have any suggestions for further development, please let us know.
